wilfred/conftest.py.name: Test isolation from owner policy
wilfred/conftest.py.description: Keeps every test run independent of the owner's real human-approvals setting on this computer, so results are the same everywhere.

wilfred/tests/conftest.py.name: Shared test set-up
wilfred/tests/conftest.py.description: Builds throwaway sample code folders and run histories that many Wilfred tests start from.

wilfred/tests/ops_fakes.py.name: Fake task tracker
wilfred/tests/ops_fakes.py.description: Provides a pretend version of the owner's task-tracking tool, with ready-made reports, so tests never touch the real one.

wilfred/tests/review_attestation.py.name: Fake review signer
wilfred/tests/review_attestation.py.description: Stands in for the independent reviewer's signature so tests can prove a review result is only trusted when properly signed.

wilfred/tests/test_acceptance_demo.py.name: Acceptance demo tests
wilfred/tests/test_acceptance_demo.py.description: Checks the demo runs all three agent designs end to end, keeps its evidence, and still demands a signed human approval.

wilfred/tests/test_adversarial_lens.py.name: Devil's-advocate review tests
wilfred/tests/test_adversarial_lens.py.description: Proves the tough-critic review is switched on automatically for sensitive work and refuses findings that come without proof.

wilfred/tests/test_approval_boundary.py.name: Human approval tests
wilfred/tests/test_approval_boundary.py.description: Proves a forged, replayed or self-declared approval cannot unlock a protected action, and a genuine signed one works only once.

wilfred/tests/test_approval_lifecycle.py.name: Approval expiry tests
wilfred/tests/test_approval_lifecycle.py.description: Checks an expired approval request must be re-issued rather than reused, and that a missing lock blocks instead of letting actions through.

wilfred/tests/test_ci_parity.py.name: Pre-push build check tests
wilfred/tests/test_ci_parity.py.description: Proves the local replay of a project's online build checks catches the same failures before anything is pushed, without exposing the owner's passwords.

wilfred/tests/test_cli_phase4.py.name: Resume and status command tests
wilfred/tests/test_cli_phase4.py.description: Checks the commands that resume an interrupted run, show its status and prepare Codex batches behave correctly and change nothing when only reading.

wilfred/tests/test_cli_phase5.py.name: Learning command tests
wilfred/tests/test_cli_phase5.py.description: Checks the commands that propose lessons, ask for approval, promote them and show the dashboard, and that promotion is refused without approval.

wilfred/tests/test_cli.py.name: Main command tests
wilfred/tests/test_cli.py.description: Checks the core Wilfred commands plan and advance a run, and fail with a clear message instead of a crash when something is wrong.

wilfred/tests/test_codex.py.name: Codex hand-off tests
wilfred/tests/test_codex.py.description: Checks the set-up given to Codex workers, including a safety hook that blocks edits to forbidden files and refusal of unsafe run names.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_attent.name: Needs-attention list tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_attent.description: Checks the command center flags waiting approvals, stale runs and unpushed work, with the right urgency and no false alarms.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_cli.py.name: Command center snapshot tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_cli.py.description: Proves the command that builds the status snapshot refuses to write inside protected or unrelated folders and reports problems without failing.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_closed.name: Closed runs list tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_closed.description: Checks runs the owner marked as closed disappear from the attention list, and a damaged closed-runs list is reported rather than trusted.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_memory.name: Memory summary tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_memory.description: Proves the command center counts shared memory notes without ever copying their text into the snapshot.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_cl.name: Task tracker option tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_cl.description: Checks the option that points the command center at the task tracker, and that a tracker failure is reported without breaking the snapshot.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_co.name: Task tracker reading tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_co.description: Checks the task tracker's reports are read safely: slow, broken or foreign reports become one clear problem, and unsafe paths never get through.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_in.name: Task alert tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_in.description: Checks pending proposals, overdue tasks and blocked tasks from the tracker turn into the right attention items, in plain Spanish.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_mo.name: Task data format tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_mo.description: Checks how tracker data is stored in the snapshot: old snapshots still open, unknown fields are refused and script-style links are rejected.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_re.name: Task display tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_ops_re.description: Checks tracker items show on the page with safe links only, and that hostile text in a task is neutralised.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_opsrea.name: Tracker reader safety tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_opsrea.description: Proves the reader can only run a short approved list of tracker commands, with a clean environment and capped output.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_projec.name: Project reading tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_projec.description: Checks the command center reads each project's code state safely, hides leaked keys in addresses and survives missing or odd folders.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_readon.name: Read-only guarantee tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_readon.description: Proves building the command center never changes a single file in the workspace and that no part can reach the internet or run stray programs.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_render.name: Command center page tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_render.description: Checks the status page shows every section in order, escapes dangerous text, works with unknown costs and warns when the data is old.

wilfred/tests/test_command_center_runs.p.name: Run reading tests
wilfred/tests/test_command_center_runs.p.description: Checks the command center reads each run's progress tolerantly, so damaged, partial or unusual run records still appear without crashing it.

wilfred/tests/test_compiler.py.name: Safety-rule builder tests
wilfred/tests/test_compiler.py.description: Proves the step that turns scope rules into enforceable files produces the right blocking hook and refuses paths that escape their run.

wilfred/tests/test_control_hardening.py.name: Run folder safety tests
wilfred/tests/test_control_hardening.py.description: Proves Wilfred refuses run folders that escape through shortcuts, plans with bad dependencies and gate names that could point outside.

wilfred/tests/test_cost.py.name: Run cost tests
wilfred/tests/test_cost.py.description: Checks token use and time are counted per run, including helper agents, with waiting-for-a-human time kept apart from working time.

wilfred/tests/test_demo.py.name: Public demo test
wilfred/tests/test_demo.py.description: Proves the public demo really goes through every stage Wilfred promises.

wilfred/tests/test_durable.py.name: Crash-proof run tests
wilfred/tests/test_durable.py.description: Checks the optional crash-resistant runner is only used when explicitly set up, and otherwise falls back to the plain path safely.

wilfred/tests/test_e2e_build.py.name: Full build walkthrough test
wilfred/tests/test_e2e_build.py.description: Walks a whole build from plan to shipping with no AI involved, proving the engine's own steps connect correctly.

wilfred/tests/test_engine_state_isolatio.name: Run notes kept out of commits tests
wilfred/tests/test_engine_state_isolatio.description: Proves Wilfred's internal run notes never get committed into the owner's code, and the check fails safely if git is broken.

wilfred/tests/test_engine.py.name: Engine tests
wilfred/tests/test_engine.py.description: Checks the core planning loop: steps run in order, work outside its allowed area is rejected and undone, and failed checks block the run.

wilfred/tests/test_escalation.py.name: Escalation tests
wilfred/tests/test_escalation.py.description: Checks that problems needing a human are written to local records and notes, with no outside service involved.

wilfred/tests/test_flaky_gate.py.name: Unreliable-test check tests
wilfred/tests/test_flaky_gate.py.description: Proves tests touched by new work must pass every time, so a test that sometimes fails blocks the work.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_architectures.name: Agent designs tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_architectures.description: Checks the three agent designs differ, that a reviewer's rejection leads to a revision, and that the agent cannot publish anything on its own.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_contract_hard.name: Agent contract strictness tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_contract_hard.description: Proves incompatible or malformed agent definitions are rejected and that leaked keys never get into saved project records.

wilfred/tests/test_foundry_core.py.name: Agent Foundry core tests
wilfred/tests/test_foundry_core.py.description: Checks the Agent Foundry's basics: stable saved format, one-question-at-a-time intake, team design rules and refusal to reuse unlicensed code.
